rules.name: 小說狂人
notes: CONFIRMED 2026-08-03 in a real Chrome: https://czbooks.net/ loads with no Cloudflare interstitial (Cloudflare Rocket Loader is active — inline handlers are rewritten — but the HTML is served normally). document.characterSet = UTF-8 on home, book, chapter and search pages.

CONFIRMED with book 《青山》 https://czbooks.net/n/s6ojkc : bookId regex '/n/([0-9a-zA-Z]+)' captures 's6ojkc' from both the book URL and the chapter URL, and does not match author URLs (/a/...) or search URLs (/s/...). chapterId regex does not match the book URL (no second path segment) and captures 's6675fe9' from https://czbooks.net/n/s6ojkc/s6675fe9. Catalog hrefs carry a '?chapterNumber=N' query which the chapterId regex correctly stops before.

CONFIRMED book fields on /n/s6ojkc: title '《青山》', author '會說話的肘子', cover 'https://czbooks.net/images/default_no_thumbnail.jpg' (this book has no real cover art; the selector points at div.novel-detail .thumbnail img which is the only cover node), category '玄幻奇幻', status '連載中', intro '洛城夜幕下的駿馬與少年郎…'.

KNOWN COSMETIC ISSUE: the title node literally contains the 《》 brackets ('《青山》'). There is no cleaner node on the page — og:title is '【免費小說】《青山》2026最新連載、線上看 | 小說狂人', which is worse. The site publishes no og:novel:* meta at all, so every book field is a selector.

CONFIRMED catalog lives on the book page itself (book URL == catalog URL). ul#chapter-list > li > a yielded 771 links for 青山, first '錯誤章' / last '第764章 不過如此武襄侯', in ascending reading order. The li.volume entries ('正文卷') carry no <a> so they are naturally skipped, and no navigation or other-book links are inside #chapter-list.

CONFIRMED chapter body is div.content. On https://czbooks.net/n/s6ojkc/s6675fe9 it returned 3521 chars starting '第1章 歸零 洛城，秋。空洞的辦公室裡，慘白的白熾燈下，中年醫生推了推鼻梁上的眼鏡。 “陳跡你好，我現在需要問你一些問題。你回答後，我會根據我的判斷，按照…'. Exactly one div.content exists on a chapter page. Paragraphs are separated by
(250 of them, no

and no child

).

CONFIRMED the largest-text-block heuristic would also land on div.content here (3521 chars, 0 links, beats div.main 3847 chars/17 links after the link penalty), but the selector is declared explicitly so a future ad block inside div.main cannot flip it.

CONFIRMED boilerplate: some chapters end with a literal '(本章完)' line (half-width parentheses) — seen on chapter s6675fe9, absent on z51cc7l. That is the only in-body boilerplate found across the two chapters sampled; there is no '請記住本站域名' style footer.

UNVERIFIED / KNOWN LIMITATION: the chapter title node is div.name and reads '《青山》第1章 歸零' — book title glued in front. Because of that prefix the extractor's title-echo dedupe does NOT strip the body's own repeated first line ('第1章 歸零') on chapters that carry one. No cleaner per-chapter title node exists on the page.

CONFIRMED search: the homepage has no <form>; search is JS-driven. czbooks.net/js/assets.js contains `searchUrl="//"+window.searchUrl+"/"+encodeURIComponent(e)+"?q="+encodeURIComponent(e)` with window.searchUrl = '//czbooks.net/s', i.e. GET https://czbooks.net/s/<q>?q=<q>. Navigating to https://czbooks.net/s/%E5%8A%8D?q=%E5%8A%8D returned a real result page (title '搜尋 劍 | 小說狂人') with 40 rows in the single ul.novel-list on the page.

CONFIRMED search rows: link 'li > div.novel-item > div.novel-item-cover-wrapper > a' -> https://czbooks.net/n/uefad, title '.novel-item-title' -> '劍來', cover 'img'. resultAuthorSelector is deliberately null: the extractor scopes row lookups via a.closest('li, tr, .item, .result, div'), which stops at div.novel-item-cover-wrapper — the author node (.novel-item-author) sits outside it, so any author selector would fall through to scope.querySelector and return the FIRST row's author for every row. Better to have no author than a wrong one.
UNVERIFIED: only one book (青山, 玄幻奇幻, 連載中) and two of its chapters were inspected. Completed books, 短篇, and 工口 categories were not checked for different markup.
